facts.label: How many e comparativos
facts.sub: Use How many + plural para perguntar quantidade: How many colors are there? Use -er + than para comparar: The blue is darker than the green.

facts.label: Quantos
facts.sub: Para perguntar quantidade de coisas que você conta, use How many + substantivo no plural: How many colors? How many shirts? A resposta pode ser six, ten ou about ten.

facts.label: Cores
facts.sub: Aprenda cores e a comparação delas: darker, lighter, brighter. Diga The blue one is darker than the green one. Use than depois do comparativo para ligar as duas coisas.

pages.title: A busy clothes store · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday afternoon in a busy clothes store in Sydney. Shirts with stripes hang on a long rack. Iris folds clothes near the door. Eva walks in with a small bag. She looks at a collar and a sleeve. Iris smiles and walks over.
“Welcome, Eva! How many shirts do you want?” says Iris. “Just two. How many colors do you have?” says Eva. “We have six colors. Red, blue, green, black, white and yellow.” says Iris.

answers: Yesterday I ___. → wanted
She ___ every day. → holds
He is ___ now. → folding
We ___ every day. → choose
